hints.title: Subsequence State Definition
hints.text: Let score[j] represent the maximum score achieved by choosing j elements from array a with matching subsequence elements from b.

hints.title: Reverse Iteration Transition
hints.text: For each number x in b, update dp[j + 1] = max(dp[j + 1], dp[j] + a[j] * x) iterating j backwards from 3 down to 0.

hints.title: Negative Infinity Base
hints.text: Initialize dp with negative infinity for indices 1 through 4, and dp[0] = 0. The final result is dp[4].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterating over n elements with 4 constant-time DP state transitions per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^4) quadruplets of indices directly causes TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed DP array of length 5 uses O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs a 4-state dynamic programming sequence alignment.
